messages.subject: Kestrel - cap table and funds flow for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Maya,

Ahead of completion, please confirm the attached two points tie to your records:

- Post-money cap table (Project_Kestrel_CapTable_Pre_and_Post.xlsx): 8,000,000 shares fully diluted, Ravensworth holding 2,000,000 Series B (25.0%).
- Funds flow (Project_Kestrel_FundsFlow.xlsx): £20,000,000 in from Ravensworth, less WC fees £162,000, Birchall Stone £75,000 and DD £38,500, leaving £19,724,500 net to the Company.

If both are agreed we'll finalise for the completion call.

Kind regards,
James
James Osei  |  Senior Associate

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
